component.name: Ignifox
component.summary: Telemetry-free, deeply customizable browser built on Firefox

description.p: Ignifox is Firefox with every telemetry, study and crash-report channel locked off, sponsored content removed, and Ignifox Studio built in.

ul.li: Ten themes plus a full seven-color palette editor, saved and shareable themes
Move tabs (top, bottom, vertical, hidden), the sidebar, bars and every toolbar button
Focus mode, corner radius, tab widths, fonts, custom CSS with live reload
Balanced, Hardened and Fortress privacy levels with a live no-telemetry proof panel
